#!/bin/sh
case "$(pwd -P)" in "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES"/*) ;; *) echo "fake: outside the golden root" >&2; exit 97 ;; esac
d=$(dirname "$0")
{
  printf 'bun %s' "$(pwd -P)"
  for a in "$@"; do printf ' [%s]' "$a"; done
  printf ' NODE_ENV=%s' "${NODE_ENV--}"
  printf ' SC=%s ORIGIN=%s TURBOPACK=%s DEPLOY=%s' "${__NEXT_PRIVATE_STANDALONE_CONFIG--}" "${__NEXT_PRIVATE_ORIGIN--}" "${TURBOPACK--}" "${NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID--}"
  printf ' TP=%s AP=%s P0=%s\n' "$GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT" "$GIT_ASKPASS" "${PATH%%:*}"
  printf '  updater.json: %s\n' "$(tr -s ' \n' '  ' 2>/dev/null < "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES/home/.claude/.claudius/updater.json")"
} >> "$d/calls.log"
. "$d/bun-scenario.sh"
exit 0

#!/bin/sh
case "$(pwd -P)" in "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES"/*) ;; *) echo "fake: outside the golden root" >&2; exit 97 ;; esac
r="$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES"
printf 'claude %s\n' "$(pwd -P)" >> "$r/home/.bun/bin/calls.log"
  printf '  updater.json: %s\n' "$(tr -s ' \n' '  ' 2>/dev/null < "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES/home/.claude/.claudius/updater.json")" >> "$r/home/.bun/bin/calls.log"
n=$(( $(cat "$r/claude-n" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
echo "$n" > "$r/claude-n"
if [ -f "$r/claude-pre.sh" ]; then . "$r/claude-pre.sh"; fi
exec "$GOLDEN_FAKE_CLI" "$@"

#!/bin/sh
case "$(pwd -P)" in "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES"/*) ;; *) echo "fake: outside the golden root" >&2; exit 97 ;; esac
d=$(dirname "$0")
{
  printf 'bun %s' "$(pwd -P)"
  for a in "$@"; do printf ' [%s]' "$a"; done
  printf ' NODE_ENV=%s' "${NODE_ENV--}"
  printf ' SC=%s ORIGIN=%s TURBOPACK=%s DEPLOY=%s' "${__NEXT_PRIVATE_STANDALONE_CONFIG--}" "${__NEXT_PRIVATE_ORIGIN--}" "${TURBOPACK--}" "${NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID--}"
  printf ' TP=%s AP=%s P0=%s\n' "$GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT" "$GIT_ASKPASS" "${PATH%%:*}"
  printf '  updater.json: %s\n' "$(tr -s ' \n' '  ' 2>/dev/null < "$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES/home/.claude/.claudius/updater.json")"
} >> "$d/calls.log"
. "$d/bun-scenario.sh"
exit 0
